# telnyx_messaging_hosted_number (Resource)

A number hosted on Telnyx for messaging only, once its hosted number order has completed. Create adopts the existing hosted number and manages its settings. Destroy keeps it unless release_on_destroy is true.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `messaging_hosted_number_id` (String) The messaging hosted number id.

### Optional

- `messaging_product` (String) The messaging product that the number is registered to use
- `messaging_profile_id` (String) Unique identifier for a messaging profile.
- `release_on_destroy` (Boolean) Whether destroy deletes the object in Telnyx. By default destroy only removes it from Terraform state. Destroy uses the value in state, so set it to true and apply before destroying.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags associated with this phone number.

### Read-Only

- `country_code` (String) ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `eligible_messaging_products` (List of String) The messaging products that this number can be registered to use
- `features` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--features))
- `health` (Attributes) High level health metrics about the number and it's messaging sending patterns. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health))
- `id` (String) Identifies the hosted number.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization that owns this phone number.
- `phone_number` (String) +E.164 formatted phone number.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `traffic_type` (String) The messaging traffic or use case for which the number is currently configured.
- `type` (String) The type of the phone number
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was updated.

<a id="nestedatt--features"></a>
### Nested Schema for `features`

Read-Only:

- `mms` (Attributes) The set of features available for a specific messaging use case (SMS or MMS). Features can vary depending on the characteristics the phone number, as well as its current product configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--features--mms))
- `sms` (Attributes) The set of features available for a specific messaging use case (SMS or MMS). Features can vary depending on the characteristics the phone number, as well as its current product configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--features--sms))

<a id="nestedatt--features--mms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `features.mms`

Read-Only:

- `domestic_two_way` (Boolean) Send messages to and receive messages from numbers in the same country.
- `international_inbound` (Boolean) Receive messages from numbers in other countries.
- `international_outbound` (Boolean) Send messages to numbers in other countries.


<a id="nestedatt--features--sms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `features.sms`

Read-Only:

- `domestic_two_way` (Boolean) Send messages to and receive messages from numbers in the same country.
- `international_inbound` (Boolean) Receive messages from numbers in other countries.
- `international_outbound` (Boolean) Send messages to numbers in other countries.



<a id="nestedatt--health"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health`

Read-Only:

- `inbound_outbound_ratio` (Number) The ratio of messages received to the number of messages sent.
- `message_count` (Number) The number of messages analyzed for the health metrics.
- `spam_ratio` (Number) The ratio of messages blocked for spam to the number of messages attempted.
- `success_ratio` (Number) The ratio of messages sucessfully delivered to the number of messages attempted.
